items.title: New n8n Vulnerability (9.9 CVSS) Lets Authenticated Users Execute System Commands
items.description: A new critical security vulnerability has been disclosed in n8n, an open-source workflow automation platform, that could enable an authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary system commands on the underlying host. items.title: GravityRAT with Remote Access Capabilities Attacking Windows, Android, and macOS Systems
items.description: GravityRAT is a remote access trojan that has been targeting government agencies and military organizations since 2016. This malware originated as a Windows-only threat but has evolved into a cross-platform tool that can attack Windows, Android, and macOS systems. items.title: WhatsApp Vulnerabilities Leak Users’ Metadata Including Device’s Operating System Details
items.description: WhatsApp’s multi-device encryption protocol has long leaked metadata, allowing attackers to fingerprint users’ device operating systems, aiding targeted malware delivery. Recent research highlights partial fixes by Meta, but transparency issues persist.
